glossary_gaps.why: NO CHINESE PRECEDENT — coinage (PROJECT.md §7.2.0; pending.json puts it in permanently_unreachable). ⚠ This OVERRIDES 破胸体, which is written in PROJECT.md §7.2.0's sketch, PARALLEL-RUNBOOK §6's stale '已钉死' line, and this unit's own index note. Grounds: (1) §7.2.0 rule 2 literally forbids the family mixing 「虫」/「体」/「者」, and the owner-locked anchor 抱脸虫 spends the 虫 slot — pairing it with 破胸体 violates the rule the sketch itself states; (2) 破胸虫 is the exact structural mirror of 抱脸虫 (动宾 + 虫, 3 chars, transparent); (3) 破胸体's only attestation is zh.wikipedia = ladder level 7, the floor, which pending.json already judged too weak to name an Actor. The runbook line that pins 破胸体 also pins 韦兰-尤坦尼集团 and 诺史莫号, both since overturned by §1.4 — it is demonstrably stale. Flip cost is one term, ~10 occurrences, one sed.

NO CHINESE PRECEDENT — coinage (pending.json phase0_cn, explicitly 'a compound Phase 0 built, not a rendering anyone attested'). Kept because it is transparent at the table and extends the settled Egg = 卵. Considered and rejected: 虫卵 (semantically excellent — the Ovomorph literally IS the 抱脸虫's egg case, and it would bind the egg into the 虫 family — but it reads as a generic parasite egg rather than a caste name, and the caste-vs-plain-noun distinction the English draws is not load-bearing anywhere in this corpus). Derived verb: ovomorph / ovomorphing = 卵化 (used 4× in this unit).

NO CHINESE PRECEDENT — coinage. ⚠ This OVERRIDES 工蜂异形, the phase0 value and the ONLY caste rendering with any external source (terminology-web.json, 'community writing', confidence medium). I am rejecting the one attested candidate deliberately, on evidence from the text pending.json itself said would settle this ('Read the Evolved core-rules bestiary text once the packs are extracted — it may gloss the ladder'): (1) THIS unit's own Drone paragraph says the Drone is the form that has NOT joined the hive mind and molts into a Worker or Soldier — calling the pre-hive solitary form 'worker-bee alien' makes the sentence 「工蜂异形…蜕变为劳工异形」 near-nonsense, and that sentence is in the shipped text; (2) 工蜂 is the WORKER bee; the drone bee is 雄蜂, so the compound is wrong twice over; (3) 雄蜂异形 fixes the entomology but imputes a sex the Xenomorph has not got. 独行 tracks what the book actually says: solitary, pre-hive-mind, 'single-minded', 'a Drone plots', stealthy ambusher, nicknamed Lurker.

NO CHINESE PRECEDENT as a caste noun, but it is the one rung with a (thin) source: terminology-web.json, plus one Alien: Earth 2025 line rendering 战士模式. Kept unchanged from pending.json. Does not appear in this unit; proposed only so the family is decided as a set (pending.json: 'deciding these one at a time guarantees an inconsistent taxonomy').

NO CHINESE PRECEDENT — coinage. 禁卫(军) is the standard Chinese for the Roman Praetorian Guard. Chose 禁卫 over pending.json's alternative 近卫 to keep 近 free — 近距离 (Short) and 近战 (Close Combat) are both LOCK terms. Does not appear in this unit; proposed for set-coherence.

NO CHINESE PRECEDENT — coinage. APPEARS IN THIS UNIT (Facehugger notes). Built on the settled Neomorph = 新变种 (level 1), which establishes -morph → 变种 as a productive suffix, plus 禁卫 from Praetorian. ⚠ Known asymmetry I am not hiding: I did NOT extend -morph → 变种 to Ovomorph (卵变种 reads badly for an object); the family tolerates this because the English is itself heterogeneous (Latinate -morph, English compounds, plain caste nouns).

NO CHINESE PRECEDENT — coinage. APPEARS IN THIS UNIT (Drone notes, Drone special). Took pending.json's second candidate over its first: 潜行异形 would collide head-on with 潜行模式 (Stealth Mode), a LOCK term that appears twice in this very unit's special text. That collision is a new finding, not in pending.json.

open_issues: ⚠⚠ #1 CROSS-UNIT LOCKSTEP, HIGHEST PRIORITY. ST-T-REST owns exactly the three tables my 4 frozen refs point at (EV - Chestburster Attacks / EV - Facehugger Attacks / EV - Stalker, Scout and Drone Attacks) and its payload DOES expose their `name` field as translatable. If that unit gives them a T-BILINGUAL name, actor.mjs:2497 `game.tables.contents.find(b => b.name === targetTable)` returns undefined and `table.roll()` throws on the next line — UNGUARDED, per DO-NOT-TRANSLATE.sections.actor_table_refs. Either those three table names stay byte-exact English, or these 4 actor refs must move in the SAME commit. Two of the four also live in corerules, so the decision is cross-repo. Run scan_table_ref_sync.py after ST-T-REST lands.

#2 THE 4 rollTable LEAVES CANNOT GO THROUGH apply_translations.py. The no-CJK gate rejects them by design (an all-English value in a translation batch). Correct assembly: OMIT those 4 paths from the batch entirely. An absent path in compendium/cn means Babele never overwrites the field, so the actor keeps the English table name at runtime — exactly the required behaviour, and better than writing English back with --force. I emit them in my unit file anyway so the controller can see they were considered, not forgotten.

#3 破胸虫 vs 破胸体 is a deliberate override of three project documents (PROJECT.md §7.2.0 sketch, PARALLEL-RUNBOOK §6, this unit's index note). Reasoning is in glossary_gaps. If the controller prefers 破胸体, it is one `sed` over ~10 occurrences in this file — but then §7.2.0's own no-mixing rule needs amending, because 抱脸虫 + 破胸体 is precisely the 虫/体 mix it forbids.

#4 独行异形 rejects 工蜂异形, the ONLY caste rendering in the whole project with an external source. I did this on the strength of the bestiary text pending.json nominated as the thing that would settle the ladder. If the controller weights recognisability above the text, 工蜂异形 comes back — but then Worker must NOT be 劳工异形, or the sentence 「工蜂异形…蜕变为劳工异形」 (which is in this unit's Drone notes) is unreadable.

#5 UPSTREAM RULES CONTRADICTION, NOT TRANSLATED AWAY. The Falling block says the Xenomorph 'can fall from great heights without suffering any damage' and then gives a damage formula (distance/4, reduced by Armor). I rendered both sentences faithfully rather than softening the first. This is the source's problem, and it is in 16 places project-wide.

#6 AMBIGUOUS RULE, translated literally and flagged. Ovomorph: 'An Ovomorph can release its Facehugger even at Short Range-roll a Stress Dice each Round. On a Failure, the Facehugger is released.' A single stress die read as a plain success roll means release on 5-in-6 per Round, which is implausibly lethal; the intended trigger is probably the die's Facehugger face (cn.json ALIENRPG.AutoPanicHint uses exactly that phrasing: 玩家掷出抱脸虫). I did NOT inject that reading — 掷出失败 is literal. Worth settling against the printed book.

#7 English typos silently corrected (not carried into the Chinese), for the record: adapte→adopt · glood loss→blood loss · diferent→different · Thee→The · occuring→occurring · greather→greater · ammor→armor · 'wiring a ship's hull'→'wiring, a ship's hull' · Xeenomorphs→Xenomorphs · injuected→injected · 'geneticist. Dr.'→'geneticist, Dr.' · 'ad are independent'→'and' · somehwere→somewhere · perfrom→perform · 'through two zone'→zones · 'comes with Engaged range'→'within'. None changes a number or a rule.

#8 'Jeremiah VI' (XX121 special) is not the Starter Set's own setting — the Starter Set is Hadley's Hope on LV-426. The stat block reads as reused from another product. I translated it (耶利米六号) rather than 'fixing' it; if the controller knows the intended location, this is a one-line change.

#9 The actor name for XX121 is the one place the bilingual convention reads redundantly: 'XX121 第四阶段异形 EV -  XX121 - Stage IV Xenomorph'. I dropped the 'EV - ' prefix from the Chinese half (the English tail carries it) and kept XX121 in front because it is the leading token a GM scans for. Note this English name contains a DOUBLE SPACE, so scan_missing_bilingual_tail.py excludes it from its check anyway — the tail is there on purpose, not because a gate demanded it.

#10 Measurement discrepancy, reported per PROJECT.md §3.7 rather than copied from the task: the brief and index.json say 20,883 raw chars for this unit; summing the payload leaves measures 20,329. Difference 554. Both index.json's raw_chars and the payload it ships are in the same file, so one of the two is stale — worth a look before the numbers are used for scheduling.

#11 Housekeeping finding: glossary_alien.disputes.json D2-engaged lists a `still_to_do` of rewriting ALIENRPG.WepTypeMelee from 近战 to 肉搏. I checked lang/cn.json this session — it already reads 肉搏. That to-do is done and can be closed.
